profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
I am a Staff Software Engineer (ICT5) at Apple working on Video Apps.

In 2025 I joined CLEAR's iOS team and led my amazing coworkers in delivering CLEAR's exceptional new app design and features. We delivered the new Vault and Home tabs, CLEAR ID, improved passport upload, reimagined flight search and Home to Gate experiences. Along the way we improved our test coverage, reduced presubmit CI times, and continued to increase the modularity and modernity of the app codebase.

Starting in 2023 and until 2025, I founded Studio.init() with 4 amazing partners to bring our digital skills together in service of our incredible clients. I brought my engineering and leadership skills to partner with our clients and deliver world-class software solutions on-time and on-budget. I mentored and led newer engineers, always ready to pair on a solution or share my expertise.

From 2017-2023 I was an iOS developer at Google in NYC.  I worked to integate the most useful iOS features and capabilities with Google's world-class apps, including Google Drive, Gmail, Google Maps, Google Photos, Authenticator, and more.  For the first 2.5 years, I worked on the Material Components for iOS component library to help make consistent, beautiful Material experiences easy to build.

From 2015-2017 I  was an iOS application developer at Audible where I learned to balance feature development with tech debt reduction and improving performance and reliability.  I am most proud of my contributions to reduce app crashes and rewriting our Discover experience.

From 2005 to 2010, I focused on indoor wireless localization (tracking Wi-Fi devices), network programming (teaching and application development), and indoor motion tracking.  In 2010 I gained experience writing back-end services linking securities ordering systems and also writing J2EE applications to support a client-facing trading platform.  Since 2011 I've expanded into front-end web development (HTML/JS/CSS), improved my J2EE skills, and embedded software for wireless radio sensors.

In 2014 I earned my Ph.D. with a thesis that described and evaluated a Wireless Sensor Network data management platform call Owl Platform.  Designed and built primarily by myself and a colleague, it featured a layered network architecture, custom network protocols, and open-source libraries in three languages.

Collaborated with design to prototype and deliver custom Vault animations and transitions. Improved build times, simplified UI testing, and simplified UX component use by embracing native SwiftUI patterns. Delivered the new Home screen, updated Home to Gate experience, Vault screen, and international passport support alongside my team.

positions.title: Partner, Engineering
positions.description:
Built TS/React sales demo for legacy Windows/C++ dental scheduling app. Launched DropOffer
for iOS, including work on iOS app (Swift/SwiftUI/UIKit), homeowner portal, and admin dashboard
(TS/React/NextJS). Yout? iOS app[1] and backend architecture (Amplify, Lambda). Jammy iOS AI
coaching app (Swift/UIKit)[2]. Unreleased fintech investor-focused asset-building product (TS/React/Next).
Contributed to technical design and code of Ping ultra-fast coffee service iOS app [3].

[2]: https://jammy.chat/
[3]: https://www.pingthru.com/

positions.title: Senior iOS Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
At Google, I worked to integrate Google's world-class apps with the most useful iOS features for our users. I launched Privacy Screen for Drive iOS and achieved 10% 7DAU usage. I launched multiple Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets on Drive and Gmail with the launch of iOS 16. I delivered multiple Material iOS Components and features internally and to Github, where I was a top contributor. I designed and led the build-out of an accessible text system for Material inside Google.

I am an accessibility expert on iOS, auditing features and advising teams on solutions and UX improvements. I led my team through multiple tech debt reduction sprints and shared my knowledge of testing and analysis tools.

positions.title: iOS Software Engineer
positions.description: I worked on the Material iOS team building beautiful, reusable UI libraries for Google and the world. I later worked to integrate some of Google's most popular apps with amazing iOS features like Face ID and widgets.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description: I worked on the Audible iOS App with a focus on app stability and tech debt reduction.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Architecture · iOS · Objective-C · iOS Development · Software Development · Agile Methodologies

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: I was one of the lead developers and architects of an industry-specific wireless sensing product.  Focused on sensor lifetimes over 8 years and low-cost deployments, I helped to define and develop a product in a start-up environment.  Requiring a combination of embedded programming, back-end development, and front-end design, I expanded my abilities and experiences.
positions.insights: Skills: Raspberry Pi · Java · Embedded Software · C

positions.title: Graduate Assistant
positions.description: I worked on components of the Global Name Resolution Service (GNRS) component of the Mobility-First Future Internet Architecture (FIA) project. http://mobilityfirst.winlab.rutgers.edu/

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: I was a TA and instructor for the Internet Technology course, which focused on the design of past and current networking technology. Outside of the classroom, I worked with students to develop their network programming skills with a BitTorrent client.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.locationName: 4 New York Plaza, New York, NY
positions.description: I worked on an interprocess communication engine that enabled faster processing of market orders. I also helped build a prototype for a client-facing web trading platform for the private bank.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: I was a TA and instructor for the Internet Technology course, which focused on the design of past and current networking technology.  Outside of the classroom, I worked with students to develop their network programming skills with a BitTorrent client.

projects.title: Material Components iOS
projects.description: Google's flagship iOS-based UI component library until its retirement in 2021. As a core team member for over 2 years, I contributed to several components, including Buttons and Typography as well as numerous bug fixes and work on the Bazel build integration.

projects.title: Owl Platform
projects.description: The Owl Platform is a Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) data management platform that makes smart spaces easier to build than ever before.  Using a network-based API we are able to combine sensor (temperature, presence, motion) and non-sensor (weather, traffic, calendars) data to produce new and exciting applications.
